scope: Corollary 11.1 (Nikodym maximal estimates in dimension three) of the manuscript “The Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions” (preprints/The-Kakeya-maximal-conjecture-in-three-dimensions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 074 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 49cc52aa3de89f0e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 94. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every 1 ≤ p ≤ 3 and ε > 0, set q = 2p′, with q = ∞ at p = 1. Then, for 0 < δ < 1, ∥NEuc δ f∥Lq(R3) ≤ Cp,εδ1−3/p−ε ∥f∥Lp(R3). For each fixed local geometry above and 0 < δ < δ0, ∥Ng δ,U f∥Lq(U,dVg) ≤ Cp,ε,U,V,gδ1−3/p−ε ∥f∥Lp(V,dVg). In particular, at p = q = 3 the operator norms are bounded by Cεδ−ε in Euclidean space and Cε,U,V,gδ−ε in the fixed local geometry.
